# Read-back

This is a 25-minute partner upper-body strength and conditioning workout for 2 lifters working simultaneously on shared equipment. The two partners alternate exercises in supersets to keep both moving without waiting for gear: while one does bench press or overhead press, the other does dumbbell rows or pull-ups. The session has four resource constraints: one flat bench with barbell (shared in Superset A), one pair of dumbbells (shared across both supersets), one pull-up bar (shared in Superset B), and two rowing ergs (one per partner, used during warm-up and available throughout). The structure is: 5-minute warm-up row together, 3-minute mobility work together, then two rounds of bench press / dumbbell row with 90-second rest after each round, then two rounds of overhead press / pull-ups with 2-minute rest between rounds but no rest after the second, then 5-minute cool-down stretch together. The whole session should take about 25 minutes total, and there is no external deadline — it finishes as soon as all work is done. The key constraint is that the bench, dumbbells, and pull-up bar exist only once each and must be handed off between partners smoothly.
